digest.component_or_area: CI workflow tickets-branch fetch and Git protocol
propositions: Apply --filter=blob:none to all tickets-branch CI fetches (actions/checkout and direct git fetch URLs) to reduce transfer size and time while retaining full commit graph for merge-base and era scoping.

Implement production pack-size guards that measure git count-objects output post-checkout and post-materialization, enforcing REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=102400 for standalone and REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=131072 for Gerrit, and fail if exceeded.

Create a real-Git fixture using git daemon with uploadpack.allowFilter and GIT_TRACE_PACKET tracing to verify that named-origin inheritance and direct-URL fetches advertise filter capability, send filter blob:none packets, and leave large historical blobs missing pre-materialization.

Ensure that blobless worktree materialization via git worktree add fetches only tip blobs needed for checkout, and that verify-identity scanning adds no additional objects (exact git count-objects before/after match).

Maintain all existing actions/checkout inputs (fetch-depth: 0, credentials, ref) and git semantics (depth forbidden on full-history, merge-base support, independent local/remote change handling) while applying the filter.
